title: brachypodium pinnatum var. longifolium
intro: Brachypodium pinnatum var. longifolium, commonly known as the tall false brome or tall false brome grass, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as treat infections. The therapeutic actions of Brachypodium pinnatum var. longifolium include acting as an antipyretic, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory agent, which can help to alleviate fever, pain, and swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
